hook: Catz was CEO of Oracle from 2014, first as co-CEO and then, following Mark Hurd's death in 2019, as sole CEO, before moving to the role of Executive Vice Chair of the board on September 22, 2025, when Clay Magouyrk and Mike Sicilia became co-CEOs. During her time as CEO, Oracle expanded Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and joined OpenAI and SoftBank in the Stargate AI infrastructure project announced January 21, 2025.

standing.standing: Safra Catz stands as Executive Vice Chair of Oracle's board of directors, a role she took on September 22, 2025. Before that she was Oracle's CEO from 2014, first as co-CEO and then as sole CEO after Mark Hurd's death in 2019. She served as sole CEO until September 22, 2025, when Clay Magouyrk and Mike Sicilia were named co-CEOs. The records list Oracle as a public company based in Austin, Texas, founded in 1977, and list Catz as an executive of it.
